description.value: John Braithwaite Community Centre is a public recreation facility operated by the North Vancouver Recreation and Culture Commission, situated in the Lower Lonsdale neighbourhood of North Vancouver. It houses a fitness centre with weight and cardio equipment, a multi-sport gymnasium supporting badminton, basketball, pickleball, volleyball, indoor soccer, and ball hockey, plus art and woodworking studios. Touring cyclists exploring the North Shore would find it a well-equipped community hub in a central, walkable district.
